title: SlotGlow
description: SlotGlow is a client-side Fabric mod that replaces Minecraft’s default hotbar selector with a fully customizable glowing highlight.
body:
# SlotGlow

**SlotGlow** is a client-side Fabric mod that replaces Minecraft’s default hotbar selector with a clean, customizable glowing highlight.

Instead of the normal gray selected-slot box, SlotGlow lets you create your own custom hotbar style with colors, glow effects, rainbow mode, opacity settings, outlines, animations, and more.

## Features

* Custom glowing hotbar selector
* Replaces the default Minecraft selected-slot highlight
* Color presets like purple, blue, green, red, gold, pink, white, and more
* RGB color sliders for custom colors
* Rainbow mode
* Pulse animation
* Glow effect settings
* Outline thickness settings
* Inner outline and double outline options
* Corner mark effects
* Opacity controls
* Slot position offsets
* Hide highlight when the selected slot is empty
* Full Mod Menu configuration screen
* Helpful setting descriptions/tooltips
* Client-side only

## Configuration

SlotGlow is configured through **Mod Menu**.

To change the settings, open Minecraft and go to:

**Mods → SlotGlow → Configure**

From there, you can customize the color, glow, rainbow mode, pulse speed, size, opacity, outline style, and more.

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Mod Menu
* Cloth Config API

## Compatibility

SlotGlow is client-side only, so it does not add blocks, items, mobs, or gameplay changes. It only changes how your hotbar looks on your screen.

Perfect for players who want a cleaner, cooler, and more personal Minecraft HUD.
